RestaurantSettings.title: RestaurantSettings
RestaurantSettings.description: Global restaurant profile configuration and thermal receipt parameters

gstNumber.description: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number

fssaiNumber.description: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India license number

logoUrl.description: Base64 data URL or web URL of the restaurant logo for thermal receipts

logoStoragePath.description: Firebase Storage path of the official immutable brand logo asset

logoStorageUrl.description: Public download URL from Firebase Storage for the official logo asset

receiptHeader.description: Custom header tagline on thermal receipt

receiptFooter.description: Custom footer message on thermal receipt

businessDayStartHour.description: Hour at which new business day cycles begin (HH:MM)

billNumberDigits.description: Number of padded digits for bill sequence

receiptFontSize.description: Base font size in px for thermal receipt output

logoRemoved.description: Whether the shop logo has been removed from the receipt

logoOffsetX.description: Horizontal drag offset in px for receipt logo positioning

logoOffsetY.description: Vertical drag offset in px for receipt logo positioning

watermarkEnabled.description: Whether the centered receipt watermark is enabled

watermarkUseLogo.description: Whether the shop logo is used as the centered receipt watermark

watermarkOpacity.description: Opacity for the centered receipt watermark

logoAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment for the shop logo

shopNameAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment for the shop name

addressAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment for the shop address

phoneAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment for the shop phone number

billHeaderAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment for the bill header

footerAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment for the receipt footer

boldRestaurantName.description: Whether the restaurant name is printed in bold

boldBillNumber.description: Whether the bill number is printed in bold

boldItemHeader.description: Whether the item header row is printed in bold

boldGrandTotal.description: Whether the grand total is printed in bold

boldFooter.description: Whether the receipt footer is printed in bold

compactMode.description: Toggles paper-saving compact mode with reduced font sizes and tighter line spacing

autoPrintOnSave.description: Whether to auto-trigger thermal print on bill save

PrintJobLog.title: PrintJobLog
PrintJobLog.description: Diagnostic print job execution log and error telemetry

DailyBackupRecord.title: DailyBackupRecord
DailyBackupRecord.description: Historical audit log of automated and manual core billing data backups

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Food availability category with optional service hours

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Single restaurant menu dish assignable to multiple availability categories via categoryIds

categoryIds.description: Array of category IDs this menu item belongs to

categoryNames.description: Resolved display names of assigned categories

UserActivityLog.title: UserActivityLog
UserActivityLog.description: Audit log of administrative user management actions (User Registered, Role Updated, Access Updated, PIN Updated, Status Changed, User Deleted)

/menu_items/{itemId}.description: Restaurant menu items supporting multi-category assignment

/print_logs/{logId}.description: Diagnostic telemetry logs for POS thermal print jobs

/daily_backups/{backupId}.description: Historical record of automated daily and manual billing database backups

/user_activity_logs/{logId}.description: Dedicated audit log collection recording user management actions, visible only to admins
